tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

dpal ldan bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di nyid kyi cho ga'i rim pa la/ dang po ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las 'di'i rjes gnang zhus nas/ rab bzhi yi bdun phan la mthun rkyen tshogs par byas te/ brgyad nas sgrub pa dngos la 'jug par bya'o// de yang rang don bdag bskyed kyi sgrub pa/ mdun bskyed dang mchod bstod bum sgrub gzungs sngags bzla ba/ gzhan don rjes gnang sbyin pa/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor dang rjes kyi cho ga'o// thog mar dkyil 'khor gtor mchod kyi rim pa ni/ stegs kyi khar maṇ+ḍal rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba la tām̐ yig ser po bri/ yi ge bcu gcig brjod bzhin pas dbus su tshom bu ser po gcig bkod/ de'i steng du man dzi'i khar 'phags mo'i sku bzhugs pa/ mdun du dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma zlum po dkar rgyan can dang*/ g.yas su rnam rgyal bum pa dri bzang chus sum gnyis bkang ba kha rgyan dung chos gzungs thag bcas pa/ g.yon du las bum/ stegs dma' bar sngon 'gro gtor ma zlum po zhig kyang bshams/ sgrub po sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs te khrus dang gtsang sbra ldan zhing*/ stan bde ba la kha nub tu ma yin par 'khod/ rang gi mdun du mchod pa dang rdor dril sogs bzhag go// gnyis pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi rim pa bsgrub pa la/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ro// de yang tho rangs bya rog skad ma grag gong nas khrus byas/ lus gnad bsrangs te 'di skad du bsam mo// bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas pa'i phyir du 'phags ma 'di nyid bsgrub pa la 'jug go snyam pa'i ngang du/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab bran/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/

kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sogs/ zhes stong par sbyangs/ stong pa nyid gyur stong pa'i ngang*// oṃ las rin chen snod yangs su// oṃ yig zhu ba las byung ba'i// gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ/ gnas bdag yul bdag grong bdag dang*// gnyug mar gnas pa la sogs pa'i// gtor mgron du 'os 'dir mchis gyur/ / ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ nam sarba ta thā te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya sa rba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba l+ya di swa hā/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum brjod/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sngags spyod don du gtor ma 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ sum bha ni sogs brjod de gtor ma dor/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos rdo rje'i zer gyis bgegs bskrad do// srung 'khor ni/ tām̐ yig 'od zer las byung ba'i// sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*// ra ba dra ba gur bla bre// ye shes me ris srung 'khor gyur// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// rin chen snod ni rgya che ba// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i nang*// bh+rūm̐ las khams gsum gyi rdzas mchog /khyad par 'phags shing mchog gyur pa'i// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas// dwangs shing thogs med kun bzang gi /rnam thar mchod sprin las lhag pa// nam mkha'i mtha' khyab ji srid du// rgyun mi chad pa'i rang bzhin gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ sogs/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/

thal mo khong stong sbyar ba nam mkha'i mdzod kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a warta a warta ya hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas ma lus kun gyi dngos// bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs pad la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs kun// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ de bzhin du dam chos dang 'phags tshogs bcas rigs 'gre la lan gsum mam lnga bdun sogs brjod/ sems bskyed ni/ 'gro kun sdug bsngal las bsgral te// bde ba mchog la rab bkod cing*// bla med byang chub la bzhag phyir// sgo gsum dge la bkol bar bya// oṃ bodhi tsit+ta u pā da ya a haṃ/ zhes sems bskyed nas/ rang nyid skad cig pad zla'i gdan// 'phags ma sgrol mar gsal ba yi// thugs kar zla dkyil dbus rang sems// tām̐ yig ser po 'od 'phro bas// lus gang sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs// 'od zer phyir 'phros po ṭa la'i// gnas nas bcom ldan sgrol ma la// sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med kyis// bskor ba nam mkhar spyan drangs bzhugs// oṃ tā re sarba bud+dha bodhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs/ tshogs zhing snying khar thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba sogs brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du rang sems nyid// tāṃ yig ser bo'i 'od kyis sems can rnams// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang nyid la bkod// sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu mnyes byas te// 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma ni// zhal bzhi sku dang rtsa zhal gser gyi mdog /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab zhal sngon po rnams// yid 'ong zhal 'dzum mdangs ldan phyag brgyad can// g.yas kyi dang pos rgyal mtshan gnyis pa yis// 'khor lo gsum pas pad+ma bzhi pa dung*// g.yon gyi dang pos bum pa gnyis pa yis// dpal gyi be'u dang ni gsum pas gdugs// bzhi pa gser nya 'dzin cing bkra shis stsol// lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs mdzes// rin chen sna tshogs du mas dbu rgyan dang*// snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub dang*// dpung rgyan do shal sogs kyis rgyan spras la// zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs bzhugs dpral bar oṃ// mgrin par āḥdang thugs kar hūm̐ de las// 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i// ye shes spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

ma lus sems can sogs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ mchod bstod brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho slar yang thugs ka yi// tām̐ las 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas// nam mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod bstod bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ gsol btab dbang bskur chu rgyun gyis sku gang*// dri ma dag cing chu lhag gyen 'khyil bas// 'od dpag med mgon mchog gis dbu brgyan gyur// de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// tām̐ yig ser po 'od zer can gyi mthar// oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re twam̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog gser btso ma// lta bus bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros// mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i tshogs rnams ma lus zhi// bkra shis 'dod don thams cad lhun gyis 'grub// 'chi med tshe dang mchog thun dngos grub ni// bde blag nyid du 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas/ de nas thun bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim bsgom na 'og tu gsal/ gsum pa mdun bskyed ni/ bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin dang*/ stong chen ngang las srung 'khor dbus// gzhal med khang pa mtshan rdzogs kyi// dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang*// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng*// tām̐ yig ser po'i sogs nas/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ bar gong ltar brjod/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ sogs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ oṃ tā re sarba bud+dha bodhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ badz+ra ā we sha ya a āḥ dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bas// 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan gyur// mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin/

chos dbyings kun tu rgyas 'gengs pas// bla ma bcom ldan 'das ma mchod// ā+oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā re ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhing khams rnam dag rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i ri rab la sogs mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams bsam yas rdo rje'i rgyan phreng 'bar/ rdo rje'i maṇ+ḍal bla med bkod pa 'di// rdo rje sgrol ma sangs rgyas kun yum la// mchog tu dad pas kun tu bdag 'bul lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ bstod pa dang 'dod gsol sbrags ma ni/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dbang phyug ma// chos nyid dbyings las sku byung la// srid gsum 'gro la thugs rjes bzung*/ ma ltar byams mdzad lha mo khyod// tshe rabs gong nas bdag gi lha// bdag nyid sgo gsum dang ba yis// lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// gser gyi mdangs can yid 'ong mas// nyon mongs gdung bas nyam thag pa'i// mi bzad tsha gdung bsal du gsol// pad+ma'i zhabs gdan dpa' gcig mo// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can// ma rig mun par rab 'thums pa'i// mi shes drwa ba bcad du gsol// dpal ldan ma gcig lha yi lha// rin chen du ma'i do shal can// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma khyod la 'dud// bdag ni thog med dus ring nas// las kyi rlung gis rab bdas shing*// ngan 'gro mu mtha' med 'khyams te// blo mig mun pas bsgribs lags na// da ni 'phags ma thugs rje can// bdag cag rnams kyi mig mdzod la// yang ye de 'dra'i sdug bsngal las// skyob par mdzod cig skyabs gcig mo// deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu// gang du skye dang skye ba der// ma gcig khyed dang mjal bar shog

/ ces byin rlabs che ba'i khyad du 'brom gyis gsungs ba de ltar brjod do// de nas gtor 'bul ni/ bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// rin chen snod du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'od zhu lha rdzas las grub pa'i// gtor ma phun sum tshogs par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mdun gyi rje btsun sgrol ma yi// lha tshogs dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa rnams// ljags kyi 'od zer sbu gu yis// gtor ma gsol bas dgyes bskyed gyur// snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar brjod/ bsnyen pa ni/ mdun bskyed thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od// snod bcud la phog rang gzhan gyi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// bkra shis phrin las rab rgyas gyur// zhes snying po'i rigs bzla/ bzhi pa bum bskyed ni/ bum pa dung chos gzungs thag dang bcas bshams/ bsang sbyangs dang*/ stong las bum byung lto ba yangs// mchu 'phyang mgrin ring mtshan nyid rdzogs// des yi dbus su bam̐ yig las// pad+ma a las zla ba dang*// tāṃ yig ser po las 'od 'phros// zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan gyur// zhes ba'i bar mdun bskyed ltar la/ mchod pa bsdu na sngags mchod tsam dang*/ spro na gong bzhin la/ bstod pa ni/ zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la// rin chen me tog mang po gcal du bkram// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang dang 'brel ba'i las bum bskyed par spro na/ las bum dbus su pad nyi'i steng*// skad cig khro rgyal rta mgrin sku// thugs kar hrīḥl sngags phreng bskor// de las 'od 'phros gnod byed bcom// slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// bum chu nus mthu phun tshogs gyur//

rta mgrin gyi snying po ci rigs bzla'o// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyis// bgegs dang bar chad bzlog par mdzod// ces brjod do// lnga pa dbang len pa spro na/ khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bla mas/ de'ang sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar chad zhi zhing mchog thun dngos grub thob pa'i ched du rje btsun ma'i dbang bskur zab mo zhu snyam du thog mar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs lan gsum dang*/ gnyis pa 'phags ma la gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes sogs lan gsum/ gsum pa thun mong du gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas bla mas/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la 'od dpag med sogs kyis// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes pa'i don bzhin ma yengs par nyon cig /tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba spu'i khung bu'ang gcod mi nus// 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma bzhin// skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan che// dbul ba la sogs nyams par byed// seṅge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad// sdug bsngal tshogs rnams sel bar byed// slong ba med par bza' btung gos// khang bzang rin chen sna tshogs 'du// ral gri mig sman rkang mgyogs dang*// bum pa bzang po la sogs grub// snyan ngag dang ni rtsod pa mkhas// blo rno shes rab dri ma med// gzhan yang ci 'dod dngos grub thob// ces sogs gsungs pas/ sgrol ma bkra shis don 'grub 'di nyid ngo bo sgrol ma dkar mo dang tha dad med phyir 'chi ba bslu ba dang*// mchog thun dngos grub myur du thob pa'i bslu med kyis skyabs gnas dam pa 'di nyid/

mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdun rnam dag 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ yig las// pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng*// tāṃ yig ser po'i 'od zer gyis// sems can don byas sangs rgyas mchod// tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// dpon slob gnyis ka sgrol ma ni// zhes pa nas/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs bzhugs dpral bar oṃ// mgrin par āḥdang thugs kar hūm̐ dang tām̐// sngags 'khor gser gyi mdog can phreng bas bskor// bla mar gsol btab mos gus tshad med dang*// rjes zlos 'di bzhin dag gsal gnang bar zhu// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma rin po ches// bdag gi 'gal rkyen kun bsal nas// rje btsun ma yi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las ma lus pa'i// byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol//

zhes lan gsum/ slob dpon thugs ka'i yig 'bru las// 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems kyi// thugs brgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi// gnyis med ye shes 'khor lo dang*// yig 'bru'i rnam par byon gyur nas// slob dpon la thim slob dpon gyi// 'khor lo yig 'brur bcas pa las// de 'dra grangs med byung gyur nas// slob ma la thim rje btsun ma'i// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs// yig 'brus lus gang sdig sgrib dag /nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi// mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur// dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ yi ge bcu gcig pa dang*/ ā we sha ya a āḥ brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya'o// zhes gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// sogs lan gsum dang*/ zhes pas gsol ba btab pa las// slob dpon thugs las 'od zer 'phros// dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs te// mngon par gsol ba btab pa las// rin chen bum pa bdud rtsi yis// gang bas bsnams te dbang bskur gyur// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes pa nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas dbang bskur dri ma dag /'chi med tshe dpal ye shes thob// chu lhag yar lud 'od dpag med// mchog gi sprul skus rgyas gdab gyur// ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar lha sku bsgom la dbang// lus sgrib byang zhing mtshan dpe sogs// sku yi yon tan ma lus rdzogs// 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub par gyur// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni// dpon slob gnyis ka rje btsun mar// gsal ba'i slob dpon thugs ka nas// sngags phreng gser gyi mdog can ni// zhal brgyud slob ma'i zhal zhugs te// thugs kar thim pas rje btsun ma'i// gsung gi dngos grub ma lus thob// sngags kyi nus mthu thob par gyur// yi ge bcu gcig pa'i rjes zlos bya/

slar yang me tog gi phreng ba zhig phul bar bsam nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ sngags phreng de nyid thod du bcings pa'i mos pa gyis shig /bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rje btsun sgrol ma'i byin rlabs kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su drang du gsol// de ltar gsung gi rjes gnang gis// bzlas pa'i rim pa byed la dbang*// ngag sgrib byang zhing tshangs dbyangs ldan// gsung gi byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs// 'bras bu longs sku 'grub par 'gyur// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni// dkyil 'khor dbus kyi sgrol ma las// mar me gnyis mched bzhin du sku// spyi bor byon nas dbyer med thim// ma bcos spros bral lhun gyis grub// yi ge bcu gcig pa'i mthar/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod me tog spyi bor bzhag / de yis mi rtog mngon du byas// yid sgrib dag nas rje btsun ma'i// thugs kyi rdo rje snying la zhugs// 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub gyur// bzhi pa yon tan rjes gnang ni// dpon slob gnyis ka lhar gsal bar// rgyan cha 'di gtad sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan dngos grub mtha' dag ldan// 'bras bu bde chen sku 'grub gyur// lnga pa phrin las rjes gnang ni// bla ma 'phags ma sgrol ma yi// gnas bzhir dkar dmar sngo ljang ser// 'od 'phros slob ma'i gnas bzhir thim// sgo gsum cha mnyam sgrib tshogs dag /phrin las mtha' yas dbang bsgyur zhing*// 'bras bu ngo bo nyid skur gyur// de ltar rjes gnang thob nas ni/ dam tshig bsrung ba'i rjes zlos mdzod// gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus dang longs spyod drug cha ni// ltos med 'bul snyam rjes zlos mdzod// deng nas brtsams ta

ེ sogs lan gsum dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ de nas thun bsdu'i rdzogs rim ni/ thugs ka'i tram̐ las 'od 'phros pas// rgyu dang mi rgyu'i snod bcud kun// 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// rang yang 'od zhu sngags 'khor dang*// de yang tām̐ yig nā dar thim// mi dmigs rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// stong nyid 'od gsal chen po'o// ār+ya tā re haṃḥ slar yang de nyid skad cig gis// chu las nya ldang ji bzhin du// gzugs sku yongs rdzogs gsal bar gyur/ rjes kyi cho ga'i rim pa las// mchod bstod byas nas bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang yig brgya brjod/ 'dod don gsol btab ni/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// gshegs gsol byed na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang gnas gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim// gshegs gsol mi byed pa dang rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// zhes pa nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// ye shes sems dpa' rten mchog 'dir// rnam pa kun tu mi 'bral zhing*// bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad la/ rtag tu thugs rjes bzung du gsol// rten 'brel snying po sogs dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de nas lha mtshan bsdus te lha la'ang bstims/ rang gi spyi bor yang bzhag / a kā ro sogs brjod/ dril bu gsil/ rdo rjes pad 'dab nas bzung*/ rdul tshon nam tshom bu gang yin gyi/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa/ sogs kyis gshegs gsol bya/ mchod gtor gtsang sar dor/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sogs kyis bsngo ba sogs gang 'os dang*/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rgyas bsdus gang 'os brjod par bya'o// de ltar 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don 'grub ma'i cho ga 'di bzhin mdor bsdus tshig bcad du bris pa ste/

bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad 'grub pa'i rtags mtshan gzhan yang gang cir rgyas par spro tshe sgrol ma'i sgrub skor gzhan nas gang 'os kha gsab chog cing*/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta a bh+ye ka ri/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'dren pa'i zhabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta gau la shrīḥ paṇ+ḍi ta kīrti/ lo ts+tsha ba kirti dhā dza/ slob dpon rin chen 'byung ldan/ bla ma rin chen gung ba/ slob dpon bsod nams 'phel/ slob dpon tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun dga' rin chen/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ bla ma dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ bla ma byams pa/ grub chen kirti shriḥ si tu chos kyi go cha/ dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug /gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /gnas mdo karma chags med/ bdud mo karma dar rgyas/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed/ des bdag la'o// de ltar 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma mchod cing bsgrub pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus 'di bzhin/ zhi ba zhes pa'i hor zla 11 tshes 1 phyi mar pa sangs nam 'bru'i 'grub sbyor dang nyi ma byang bgrod bskyed rim thog ma zla ba'i rlung rgyu'i rten 'brel bcas/ gang cir phun sum tshogs pa'i dus der shākya'i dge slong karma ka bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rjes lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas spel ba dge// / ༈ 'phags ma bkra shis don grub ma'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bsam 'phel nor bu bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa dang lhag pa'i lha gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan zhing rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pas rgyas pa'i las bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par bya ba dang*/ sngags dang cho ga'i lhag chad kha skong ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi las dang*/ rten rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe sbyin sreg gi las brtsams te dpal yang dag bar sbyor ba las/

sna tshogs las ni rab bsgrub phyir// sbyin sreg las ni bshad par bya// me ni lha yi kha ru gsungs// sbyin sreg de ni rnam par gnas// sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim// tshim nas dngos grub rab tu stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag //sbyin sreg gis ni de kun dag /ces dang*/ ci gsungs sbyin sreg byas nas ni// dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs pa dang*// zhes dang*/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ rab gnas la sogs rjes la ni// ma dran pa dang ma nus pa// cho ga ma tshang gyur pa rnams// sbyin sreg gis ni rdzogs par bya// zhes gsungs so// des na las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// dang po la gsum ste/ thab bca' ba/ yo byad rnams ji ltar bshams pa// slob dpon gyi chas gos sogs bstan pa'o// dang po ni sam+bu ṭi las/ rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ste// khru gnyis tshad du rnam par rgyas// 'og tu khung bu gru gang ba// mu ran la ni sor brgyad nyid// me tog ser pos brgyan pa dang*// dri ni ser pos rjes su byug /gang du sbyin sreg bya ba'i gnas su stegs bu 'du bya ba sogs grub nas thog mar thig gdab pa ni/ tshangs zur bzhi po legs btab ste// dbus nas tshangs steng sor mo ni// nyer bzhi tshan gcig brgyad tshan gnyis// mtshan mar byas la de steng nas// zur thig steng du mtshan mar bya// de steng gru bzhi phyogs re la// gsum gsum btab pas thab rgya dang*// mu ran kha khyer yang dag 'byung*// sor mo brgyad dang bcu drug gi /pad+ma'i lte bar 'dab ma bskor// dkyus thig btab pas rgyas pa 'grub// de ltar thig rnams gdab par byas nas/ de nas thab khung brtsig pa ni/ rgyas pa la mchu'i phyi nang gi thig gnyis kyi bar du gru bzhir brtsig pa'i rgya phyed dpang du yod pas kha nas sor brgyad pa'i mchur dor ba rgya dpang mnyam par sor brgyad pa'i kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng ba dang bcas pa/

pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbyibs lta bu nang du ngang gis gzhol ba/ de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir rin po che ser pos mtshan pa dbus su pad 'dab brgyad de phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ lte ba ljang khu'i steng du rin po che ser po/ 'khor yod tshe phyogs kyi 'dab ma la so so'i lha mtshan dgos shing*/ tshon gzhan ma 'byor tshe ser po kha rkyang bkram pa'i steng du gong ltar bris pas 'thus/ brko thab byed na kha khyer gyi rtsa thig de nang du thab rang gi rgya yi phyed zabs su brko zhing*/ bri thab la ni dpang dngos su med kyang bsam pas 'grub bo// thab kyi kha dog dang dbyibs sogs ni gong gi lugs dang 'og tu thab kyi bskyed chog gis rtogs par 'gyur ro// des na 'dir smos pa rnams ni dper brjod pa tsam yin no// bud shing ni yam shing so so'i rgyu dang mthun pa'am shug pa sogs dri zhim po dang*/ dgon pa'i ba lang lci ba srog chags med pa yang rung ste thab kyi dbyibs dpangs rnams mthun par rgyas pa la thab kyi mchu yi nang du dam par brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor rdza'i kong bu mar gyis bkang ba sdong bu can bzhag go// gnyis pa yo byad rnams ji ltar bshams pa ni/ rgyas pa la slob dpon gyi g.yon phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin chu bzhi/ nyer spyod lnga/ mar la bcos pa'i gtor ma dang bcas pa stegs bu mtho dman nam phyi nang byas pa'i khar 'das ma 'das kyi tshar gnyis bshams/ ma 'byor na tshar gcig spyi sor bshams la/ mchod 'bul re re bzhin mchod pa rnams brje ba'ang kha gso/ yang g.yas phyogs kyi mdun ngos nas brtsams te snga ma bzhin du byang chub kyi shing sogs dang*/ khyad par du rgyas pa la yam shing gi rgyu de nyid kyi yal ga'i dbus kyi cha las byung ba 'o ma dang mar gyis bsgos shing gur gum gyis byugs pa/ srid du gru gang*/

sboms su chang gang*/ ba'am ra'i mar gyi khu ba/ til nag yungs kar/ zho/ bag phye/ bu ram gsum mam/ 'o ma sbrang rtsi zhib bsres pa'i ril bu'i zas mchog dang*/ zho/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūrba/ ku sha sngon po rtsa rtse ma nyams pa mar dang 'o mas sbags pa dang*/ shing tog sna tshogs rnams bshams/ yang na rgyas pa la sā li dmar po/ me tog brgya pa/ bil ba'i 'bras bu/ pad+ma/ nā ga ge sar/ 'bru dag go// rgyas pa'i mchod rdzas dang stegs bu'i kha dog ser po bya zhing*/ de dag gi snod kyang gser sogs ser po dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun me yol gyi nang du g.yon nas rim bzhin me lha'i gdan kyi ku sha chun po bcu/ nang mchod/ rdo rje/ dgang blugs kha sbyar/ dril bu/ me tog bsang gtor gyi ku sha /rlung g.yab rnams bshams/ gzhan yang las mthun gyi khrus ras dang gos zung dag kyang bsham mo// gsum pa slob dpon gyi chas gos sogs bstan pa ni/ chas gos ser po dang*/ rgyan ni gser sogs rin po che'o// slob dpon gyi kha lta phyogs ni/ rgyas pa la byang du blta bar sam+bu ṭi las gsungs shing*/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ thab dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang du bya ba'ang*/ de nyid las/ byang du rgyas pa'i thab khung nyid// ces gsungs pas dkyil 'khor gyi zhal gang du phyogs kyang rung*/ las dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su thab bca' zhing*/ slob dpon ni las dang mthun pa'i phyogs su kha blta ba'am/ yang na sbyin sreg dang 'brel ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi zhal nub phyogs su blta bar bzhengs na rgyas pa la sogs pa'i las kun la dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang du bya ba dang*/ slob dpon gang du kha blta ba'i 'byung ba'i phyogs gnyis ka mi 'gal bas shin tu 'grigs shing legs par mngon no// slob dpon gyi gdan dang 'dug stangs ni/ rgyas pa la khri'u ser po'i steng du bzang po'i 'dug stangs bya'o// dus ni yar ngo'i tshes brgyad sogs kyi snga dro'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/

'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ bdag nyid khrus byas las dang mthun pa'i tshon dang dris byugs/ de nas bdag bskyed bsgom zhing thun bsdu sogs byas la/ slar yang*/ bdag nyid skad cig khro bo'i rgyal// he ru ka dpal rta mchog dmar// phyag gnyis dbyug tho sdigs mdzub can// 'dor thabs khro chas rdzogs par gsal// 'di nas bzung ste sbyin sreg ma grol gyi bar du ngag smra bcad/ lag pa rdor dril/ yid ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar dgos shing*/ rdor dril byin rlabs sngar byas pa med na 'dir byin rlabs dgos pas/ mdun du las bum zhig bcas la/ las bum dbus su pad nyi'i steng*// skad cig khro rgyal rta mgrin sku// thugs kar hrīḥl sngags phreng bskor// de las 'od 'phros gnod byed bcom// slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// bum chu nus mthu phun tshogs gyur// rta mgrin gyi snying po ci rigs bzla'o// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyis// bgegs dang bar chad bzlog par mdzod// ces brjod do// slar rdor dril la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa

kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ rdor dril mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdor sems yab yum dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku'i/ gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa// dbang gi lha bcas spyan drangs te// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho ye shes pa// dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// slar yang dbang lha 'khor bcas kyis// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag spyi bor brten pa las// mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan gyur// rdor sems yab yum zhu ba las// rdor dril mtshan nyid ldan par gyur// lag mthil g.yas su zla ba dang*// g.yon du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal// bar bsams te pad kor dang bcas pas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje blangs te gsor/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe āḥ zhes pad kor dang bcas te dril bu blangs la slar yang pad kor dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod bzhin pas rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ slar bstod de snying gar bzung ngo*// de nas dril bu gnas brgyad du bskor zhing gsil ba ste dril lce dril bu'i nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du res mos kyis reg pa gsil bzhin par/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sa rba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li ni pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha wi ta badz+ra dharma hri da yaṃ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥ hoḥ.ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod la pad kor byas te rdo rje snying gar bzung zhing dril bu sgra che bar gsum bkrol bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sgras bskul zhing mchod par bsams te grag stong du mnyam par bzhag go// de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma la

oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes stong par sbyangs/ stong pa nyid gyur stong pa'i ngang// oṃ las rin chen snod yangs su// oṃ yig zhu ba las byung ba'i// gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ oṃ gnas bdag yul bdag grong bdag dang*// gnyug mar gnas pa la sogs pa'i// gtor mgron du 'os 'dir mchis gyur// ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya sarba tha khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛ h+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā te swā hā/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a d+ya nu t+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sngags spyod don du gtor ma 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs brjod de gtor ma dor/ yungs kar gyi rdzas dang yo byad kun la brab cing yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos rdo rje'i zer gyis bgegs bskrad do// srung 'khor ni/ tām̐ yig 'od zer las byung ba'i// sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*// ra ba drwa ba gur bla bre// ye shes me ri'i srung 'khor gyur// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ me spar ba ni/ gtsub shing las byung ba'am rung khang las byung ba'i me/ khyad par nags la me mched pa las byung ba'am me shel las byung ba gang rung me snod du bzhag /bsang chu gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyis bsangs/ dpal 'bar la sbar te slar yang bsang chu gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes thab kyi shar lhor bzhag / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod de rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing sbar ro/

yang bud shing nyung ba lta bus mgyogs par dgos tshe me lha'i gdan bshams nas sam me lha bskyed nas me sbar ba'ang yod do/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyis mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul bas me gsos la/ sam+bu ṭir/ thab khung kun tu ku sha yi// rtse mo drang por yongs su bskor/ zhes pa ltar ku sha'i chun po ma nyams shing ha cang ring thung spangs pa zung du byas pa dag rim par blangs te lag gnyis kyi bzung ba cung zad pad kor dang bcas te/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ ces chun po che ba zung zhig thab kyi steng du rtse byang du blta bas bzhag ste me lha'i gdan du bsam/ chun po gzhan dag ni rang gi phyogs g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du rim pa ltar rtse mo byang dang shar lho nub tu blta bar snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa bar non par skor thabs su dgram mo// 'di ni me lha'i gdan dang sbyin sreg gi bya ba la srung 'khor du yang 'gyur bas thog mar bya zhing thab bskyed pa'i gong ngam 'og tu byed pa'ang yod do// de nas mchod rdzas byin brlab pa ni/ ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ gyis zhabs bsil/ añcha mā naṃ gyis zhal bsil/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis 'thor 'thung ste/ chu bzhi go rim rgyud so so nas nges med du gsungs pas gang 'os su sbyar te/ gang ltar mchod pa byin rlabs dngos ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// rin chen snod ni rgya che ba// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i nang*// bh+rūm̐ las khams gsum gyi rdzas mchog /khyad par 'phags shing mchog gyur pa'i// mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil dang*// 'thor 'thung me tog bdug spos sogs// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas// dwangs shing thogs med kun bzang gi

/rnam thar mchod sprin las lhag pa// nam mkha'i mtha' khyab ji srid du// rgyun mi chad pa'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ añca ma naṃ/ pro k+ṣa naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ dī bam̐/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ thal mo khong stong sbyar ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta ya a brta ya hoḥbadz+ra s+pha ra ṇaṃ/ zhes mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas sreg rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// rin chen snod du oṃ ā hūm̐// 'od zhu lha rdzas las grub pa'i// sreg rdzas phun sum tshogs par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin la// rnam pa sreg rdzas so sor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ ཿ zhes lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas blugs gzar dang*/ g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas dgang gzar bzung la kha sbyar te mar khu la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ yam shing la reg ste/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ rdzas sbyangs ba'o// yang sreg rdzas thams cad la rim bzhin rig ste/ oṃ swā hā/ rdzas bkru ba'o// yang rdzas thams cad la rim par reg ste/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas thab bskyed pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyis bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ thab khung mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng// rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ser// lag khru do yi rgya khyon can// rgya phyed dpangs ldan sor brgyad kyi// mchu dang kha khyer de steng du// rin chen ser po'i phreng ba dang*// gra bzhir rin chen dag gis spras// de dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad lter// rgyas pa'i rin chen ser pos mtshan// thab kyi dbus su me dkyil nang*// pad nyi'i steng du raṃ yig las// rgyas pa'i me lha ser po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis me thab dang*// ril ba 'dzin pa drang srong tshul// ral pa'i tshogs bcas brjid nyams ldan// gsus 'phyangs tshangs skud ser pos brgyan// ra skyes la gnas 'khor bcas kyi// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros shar lho nas// me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// oṃ/

tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi rgyal po bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// bzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad rab bsgrub pa// thugs rjes sems can don gyi phyir// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/ ku sha dang bcas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa bar g.yob cing spyan drangs te/ thab kyi shar lhor me tog gcig 'thor la/ thab kyi shar lhor ku sha yi// gdan la me lha ye shes pa// 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur// zhes brjod/ bzed zhal so sor chu bzhi sgreng ste/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pād+yaṃ/ añca mā naṃ/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ zhes pas chu bzhi dbul/ de nas lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan pa rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta dz+wa la ya sarba pā pān bhasmīn ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dri sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes dam la bzhag / dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥye shes pa// dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu zhabs spyi bor brten pa las// rin 'byung gis ni dbu brgyan gyur// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da 'i bar gyis gdan mchod dbul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭā k+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// me lha cung zad zhal gdangs ba'i// ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan pas// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// na ma sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ oṃ ag+na ye ha bya ka bya bā hā nā ya ā di bya/

ces lag gnyis rdor dril dang dgang blugs 'dzin cing byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun byon zan du 'bul te/ spel tshig ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*// nor dang longs spyod snyan grags sogs// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes 'dod don gsol zhing sngags tshig rnams brjod bzhin pas lag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pas rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang nas dgang blugs bzung*/ g.yas pas blugs gzar gyis mar khu gsum mam bdun sogs dgang gzar du blugs te gang ba dang*/ lag gnyis sngar bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya de kha sbyar/ blugs gzar mar khus gang ba dgang gzar gyi steng du 'dzin pa'am kha sbyar la gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis las mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor zhing*/ mar khu dgang gzar gsum mam bdun gyis byon zan 'bul/ me pra skabs 'dir kho nar brtag pa dang 'di nas brtsams te ji srid thab kyi bud shing rnams nus pa ma rdzogs pa de srid du brtag pa ste lugs gnyis la snga ma ltas btags la/ de'i tshul ni/ sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye mar/ rab bsngags dge ba'i me yi 'od// dpal be'u dang ni rnga yab gdugs// rgyal mtshan pad+ma dril bu dang*// rtse gsum pa dang ral gri nya// bkra shis in+d+ra ni la'i mdog /rdo rje dung la sogs pa dang*// dgang gzar blugs gzar rnam pa dang*// dkar dang 'ja' 'dra mdog sdug dang*// g.yas su 'khyil dang shin tu snum// byu ru dang ni gser mdog 'dra// dngul dang rin chen baiḍūr+ya// nyi 'od 'bar mtshungs dri ma med// du ba med cing dri zhim pa// mṛ taṅga yi sgra ldan mchog /ces pa rnams ltas dge bar shes par byas la/ 'on te mi dge ba'i mtshan ma yang de nyid las/ du ba dku zhing me stag 'phro// kun nas ldang zhing sgra dang bcas// myur du chad cing zhen pa dang*// mdangs rtsub pa la sha li mdog

/de bzhin ba lang mgo 'dra dang*// mi ro'i dri dang nya yi dri// bong bu'i dri can bgegs yod yin// zhes pa rnams kyis me pra brtag /ngan na bsang chu gtor zhing las sngags dang sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad/ ha bya sogs byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun 'bul lo// de nas sreg rdzas dbul te/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing du mos la rtse mo steng du bstan la g.yas pas mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul zhing*/ a ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ zhes sngags re dang yam shing re bstun te dbul zhing sngags bzla grogs yod na du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yam shing sngags re la dbul/ grangs 'dzin pa pos kyang grangs 'dzin pa ste/ deng sang sbyin sreg la grangs rkun byed pa'ang 'di nas 'chug pa yin pas grangs rkun mi byed cing tshar gsum re'am bdun re'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya zhes pa'i rjes su/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun/ sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes til nag mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// sdig sgrib zhi byed las rnams dang*/ dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dhi ye swā hā/ yungs kar te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gdon bgegs zhi byed las rnams dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

oṃ ag+na ye sa pa re wā ra oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa re wā ra oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kun// shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/

'bras so ba ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ya badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā/ so ba ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// nor dang 'bru rnams rgyas pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ nas te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi shugs rnams rgyas pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā bā la ya swā hā/ sran ma ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// las kyi stobs rnams rgyas pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ gro ste/ bdag cag dpon 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi nad rnams med pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// tshe srog gong du 'phel ba dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ ku sha ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ṣe bā ya swā hā/

shing tog sna tshogs te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ de yang sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na til lhag par 'bul zhing gzhan rnams gang 'byor ram ma 'byor kyang rung ngo*// de bzhin du tshe ring bar 'dod na dūrba 'bul ba sogs kun la shes par bya/ mar khu dang yam shing ni thams cad la dgos so// bde mchog sdom 'byung sogs las ni/ yam shing ni dkyil 'khor la'o// khu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal du'o// gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu'o// ku sha ni gdan du'o// dūrba dang me tog ni dbu la'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar byed pa'ang yod do// me gso ba'i phyir bar bar du mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul lo// de yang sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na til/ tshe ring bar 'dod na dūrba/ bgegs zhi bar 'dod na yungs kar sogs mang bar dbul/ grangs kyang gtso bor de la sogs pa ltar so so'i skabs thob dang bstun/ mar khu dang yam shing ni med ka med do// de nas me lha'i mchod bstod ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra dhu pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i snang gsal 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i dri chab 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ma taṃ gi pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes brjod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭāk+kis dbang bskur ba/ shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ drang srong chen po me lha yis// sngon gyi dam bcas ma dor bar// lha rnams zhal ni me yin te/ sbyin sreg de ni me la gnas// oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyi bsangs chus me dang yo byad rnams bsangs la/ me lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'od zhu 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur// par bsam mo// gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga ni/ me lha'i lto ba'am thugs ka'am me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ste/ lugs gsum las phyi ma ltar byas te/ de yi ngang las srung 'khor dbus// gzhal med khang pa mtshan rdzogs kyi// dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang*// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng*// tām̐ yig ser po 'od kyis sems can rnams// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang nyid la bkod// sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu mnyes byas te// 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma ni// zhal bzhi sku dang rtsa zhal gser gyi mdog

/g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab zhal sngon po rnams// yid 'ong zhal 'dzum mdangs ldan phyag brgyad can// g.yas kyi dang pos rgyal mtshan gnyis pa yis// 'khor lo gsum pas pad+ma bzhi pa dung*// g.yon gyi dang pos bum pa gnyis pa yis// dpal gyi be'u dang ni gsum pa gdugs// bzhi pas gser nya 'dzin cing bkra shis stsol// lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs mdzes// rin chen sna tshogs du mas dbu rgyan dang*// snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub dang*// dpung rgyan do shal sogs kyi rgyan spras pa// zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs bzhugs dpral bar oṃ// mgrin par āḥdang thugs kar hūm̐ de las/ 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i// ye shes spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// sogs dang*/ stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa sogs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ thab kyi dbus su pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥslar yang thugs ka yi// tām̐ las 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas// nam mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod bstod bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ gsol btab dbang bskur chu rgyun gyis sku gang*// dri ma dag cing chu lhag gyen 'khyil bas// 'od dpag med mgon mchog gis dbu brgyan gyur// de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// bcom ldan 'das ma'i ljags la yang*// tām̐ yig dag gis mtshan pa yis// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ lan bdun nam gsum/ spel tshig ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*// nor dang longs spyod snyan grags sogs// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las//

sogs nas/ s+pha ra na khaṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil ba/ 'thor 'thung me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin// chos dbyings kun tu rgyas 'gengs pas// bla ma bcom ldan 'das ma mchod// oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā re ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhūpe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhing khams rnam dag rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i ri rab la sogs mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams bsam yas rdo rje'i rgyan phreng 'bar// rdo rje'i maṇ+ḍal bla med bkod pa 'di// rdo rje sgrol ma sangs rgyas kun yum la// mchog tu dad pas kun tu bdag 'bul lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ bstod pa dang 'dod gsol sbrags ma ni/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dbang phyug ma// chos nyid dbyings las sku phyung la// srid gsum 'gro la thugs rjes bzung*// ma ltar byams mdzad lha mo khyod// tshe rabs gong nas bdag gi lha// bdag nyid sgo gsum dang ba yis// lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// gser gyi mdog can yid 'ong mas// nyon mongs gdung bas nyam thag pa'i// mi bzad tsha gdung bsal du gsol// pad+ma'i zhabs gdan dpa' gcig mo// nyi ma 'bum gyi bzi brjid can// ma rig mun par rab 'thums pa'i// mi shes drwa ba bcad du gsol// dpal ldan ma gcig lha yi lha// rin chen du ma'i do shal can// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma khyod la 'dud// bdag ni thog med dus ring nas// las kyi rlung gis rab bdas shing*// ngan 'gro mu mtha' med 'khyams te// blo yid mun pas bsgrib lags na// da ni 'phags ma thugs rje can// bdag cag rnams kyi mig mdzod la// yang ye de 'dra'i sdug bsngal las// skyob par mdzod cig skyabs gcig mo// deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu// gang du skye dang skye ba der// ma gcig khyed dang mjal bar shog

/ ces byin rlabs che ba'i ched du 'brom gyi gsungs pa de ltar brjod nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ bo bhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ zhes re dang yam shing re bstun la 'bul/ zla grogs kyi grangs dang bstun nas 'bul zhing*/ grangs rkun mi byed par grangs 'dzin pa sogs gong 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar bya zhing bzlas pa'i kha skong gi grangs gsog pa'ang 'di bzhin gsog dgos so// de'i mthar/ dhṛ k+ṣa ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes til nag mtheb srin gyis dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// sdig sgrib zhi byed las rnams dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ye swā hā/ yungs kar te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gdon bgegs zhi byed las rnams dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ zas mchog ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ zho ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bī dza ya swā hā/ so ba ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// nor dang 'bru rnams rgyas pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ nas te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi shugs rnams rgyas pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun/ sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā ta re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā bā la swā hā/ sran ma ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi stobs rnams rgyas pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ gro ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi nad rnams med pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// tshe srog gong du 'phel ba dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ ku sha ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tām̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ zhes shing tog sna tshogs te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

de yang sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na til lhag par dbul zhing*/ gzhan rnams gang 'byor ram/ ma 'byor kyang rung la/ de bzhin du tshe ring bar 'dod na dūrba sogs kun la shes par bya/ mar khu dang yam shing ni med ka med do// de nas na bza' dang me tog bdug spos sogs dbul tshig 'di bzhin bya/ na bza' phal cher na bza' bla bre dang*// na bza' bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// na bza' sna tshogs rab tu bkram byas nas// rgyal ba bdag nyid chen po de dag mchod// oṃ ār+ya tā re gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā re bh+ya/ badz+ra spar+she pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ me tog phal cher= puṣ+pe/ bdug spos phal cher= dhū pe= rnams kyis dbul zhing*/ rin po che dang sman sogs kyang snying po'i mjug tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la phul/ khrus ras dang gos zung yang bshams gsungs pa'i rigs pas khrus byed par spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ de dag sku la sogs/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sogs/ de dag sku la sogs/ lhag bsam sogs/ sna tshogs dbang po'i sogs/ srab 'jam sogs/ zhes khrus kyis gos zung dbul ba sogs bya'o// mi spro na ma byas kyang chad skyon med/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams/ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// 'og ma mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung gong bzhin mchod bstod tshar rjes/ gtor 'bul ni/ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ sā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las/ rin chen snod du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'od zhu lha rdzas las grub pa'i// gtor ma phun sum tshogs par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mdun gyi rje btsun sgrol ma yi// lha tshogs dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa rnams// ljags kyi 'od zer sbu gu yis// gtor ma gsol bas dgyes skyed gyur//

snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ snying po gsum mam bdun gyis mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun dbul/ thal mo sbyar la/ lhag pa'i lha mchog bcom ldan 'das// 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du// 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab po// mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyis 'dod dgu'i char bab pas tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang gzi byin rgyas par bsgoms/ de nas gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā re ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ bar gyis mchod nas/ zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la// sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags nas/ gshegs gsol gyi skabs su/ oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā re añca mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin thog mtha' 'dra bar/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ zhes zhabs bsil dang 'thor 'thung dbul la mchod yon sbreng bzhin pas yig brgya brjod/ oṃ/ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzod// sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang gnas gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim// gshegs gsol mi byed pa dang rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// zhes pa nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// ye shes sems dpa' rten mchog 'dir// rnam pa kun tu mi 'bral zhing*// bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad la// rtag par thugs rjes bzung du gsol//

rten 'brel snying po sogs dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor/ sprul pa'i dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying ga'i gnas su thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ oṃ ag+na ya dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul nas/ slar yang me lha 'khor bcas rnams// 'bar ba'i rnam pa las bzhengs te// drang srong dag gi cha byad can// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur// par bsams la/ sreg rdzas lhag ma gang yod grangs tshad mi 'dzin par gong 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar sor bzhag 'bul zhing 'don dgos pas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bodhi brik+ṣa ya swā hā/ yam shing ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// zhes pa nas shing thog tshang ba'i bar brjod/ khrus gsol spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra wās+t+rā sogs kyi bar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ mchod bstod ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /sogs kyis bstod/ me lha'i gtor ma/ a kā ro sa byin gyis brlabs te/ dgang blugs bzung la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum brjod bzhin pas thab khung du 'bul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ 'dod don gsol ba ni thal mo sbyar te/ drang srong chen po me yi lha// 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgyu bcas kun// zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du// 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol//

de nas yig brgya brjod la/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// sogs kyis bzod par gsol la/ gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ ag+na ye sa par ri wā ra añca mā ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ zhes brjod/ yig brgya brjod bzhin pas mchod yon sbreng ste gshegs gsol gyi dril stabs dang bcas pas/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrub kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar 'byon te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ ye shes me lha shar lhor gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams snying gar thim// de nas bsngo ba smon lam byas/ ngag grol/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis mthun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug /long yod na thab kyi me mi bsgul bar bzhag /long med na 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chus me mtha' nas zhi bar byas la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas bsdus te rgya mtshor 'babs pa'i chu bor 'dor ba sogs las kyi rjes mi mngon par bkra shis brjod do// ces pa'ang phur sgrub bla ma phrin las kyis rgyal ba karma pas mdzad pa'i bkra shis don grub mar rgyas pa'i sreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor sgrib gnyis sreg byed sor bzhag byas te si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos sa zla'i yar tshes la zin thor spel ba dza yan+tu/// /
